verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an open-source benchmarking tool for load-testing throughput and latency on deployments. It also states a target that Fast variants aim for 100+ tokens per second, but this is an aspiration rather than published measured results backing its speed claims. missing for 10: published per-model tokens-per-second or latency benchmark results, methodology behind the speed and Fast-mode claims, independent or hands-on corroboration of the numbers.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims

citations.quote: Use our open-source benchmarking tool to measure and optimize your deployment's performance
This tool allows you to: Test throughput and latency under various load conditions
Fast variants aim for 100+ tokens per second
